subject: Next steps & technical checklist for 30-day evaluation — Aperture Analytics
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@aperture.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Summary + proposed 30-day evaluation scope (post-call)

Emma — thanks for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a concrete next-steps checklist so we can get the evaluation started next week. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you'd prefer to walk this through.

Key pain points you called out:
- Fast, low-cost inference for live support summarization during high traffic spikes (weekends).
- Concerns about latency variability at scale and cost per inference for short documents (~250 tokens).
- Data residency / retention policies for customer transcripts (compliance team).

Goals for the 30-day evaluation
- Validation of latency SLO: p99 < 220ms for inference on our selected prompt set (95% of traffic expect < 120ms).
- Unit cost target: average per-request token cost <= $0.0015 (including batching benefits).
- Quality: human-eval F1 >= 0.82 on the summarization prompt set we discussed (seed set attached).
- Operational: ability to run a live A/B between your current endpoint and Redwood for a subset (5%) of traffic.

Proposed scope and timeline
- Duration: 30 calendar days (start window: next week).
- Workloads: 2 model routes — "summaries-short" (250 tokens) and "summaries-long" (up to 1024 tokens); expected peak concurrency ~120 req/s.
- Owners: Aperture (data & product lead) + Redwood (AE: me; SE: Rishi; CS: Rachel).
- Success criteria: the three goals above + no production-impacting errors >1% of requests.

Technical access & items we need from Aperture to start
1) Sample dataset: 500 representative transcripts (anonymized) — S3 link or shared Drive.
2) A test account or service account for Redwood to ingest data + a point of contact for network/VPC questions.
3) Procurement contact to sign the evaluation SOW (we can do a short SOW + PO).
4) Confirmation if you need a private VPC evaluation (on-prem style) vs hosted trial.

Prompt set & evals
- Attached: seed_prompt_set.csv (10 canonical prompts + expected outputs) for initial automated and human evals.
- We will run deterministic evals and a blinded human round near day 21 to validate F1.

Attachments referenced:
- pilot-charter-template.docx (attached)
- seed_prompt_set.csv (we'll upload to Drive if preferred)

Next steps (action items)
- Emma: share sample data link + confirm procurement contact (ideally today or tomorrow).
- Aperture procurement: review the short SOW (I attached a draft) — we can accept a PO.
- Rishi (cc'd): once we have the sample set, please advise on the exact S3 layout and presigned link approach.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0173

Thanks, Vanessa — this is great and matches our notes. A few quick items: 

• Procurement: looping in Liam Ortiz (liam@aperture.ai) who owns POs for evaluations — Liam, hi.
• Compliance: our security lead wants to confirm you have an up-to-date SOC 2 report and a standard data retention policy for trial artifacts (we generally require data purging after 90 days unless agreed).
• Data: I can share an S3 bucket with anonymized transcripts by EOD tomorrow. Will that work?

On scope — the 5% traffic A/B sounds ideal. We may start with a smaller concurrency (40–60 req/s) and scale during week 2 to validate behavior under peak.

Cost/pricing ask: could you provide a rough cost estimate (hosted trial) for the expected traffic so we can prep the proper PO? Also please send the SOW draft to Liam.

One more note — we use an internal tagging field in transcripts called "session_flags"; if you can preserve that in the sample, it helps our QA folks match evals to sessions.

Appreciate it,
Emma
Product Manager | Aperture Analytics
emma@aperture.ai

Liam / Emma — thanks for jumping in. Liam: welcome — I've attached a short evaluation SOW (SOW-draft.pdf) and an onboarding checklist.  

Answers to immediate questions:
- SOC 2: here's a link to our current report: https://redwood.app/security/soc2-report.pdf (control summary included).
- Data retention: standard evaluation policy is auto-purge after 90 days; we can shorten to 30 days if needed for Aperture. Please confirm.
- Pricing (hosted trial rough): estimated $1,200–$1,900 for a 30-day evaluation based on expected volume (includes token fees + transient infra). If you want a dedicated trial environment, add ~ $3k setup + $800/week for reserved capacity.

Attachments included: SOW-draft.pdf, onboarding-checklist.csv. If procurement wants a PO, the SOW gives the line items and we can accept Aperture's PO against the SOW.

Next technical steps (Rishi): once Emma shares the S3 link we will validate the schema and provide a presigned ingest path and a short script to anonymize/preserve the "session_flags" tag.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0–2: sign SOW / PO + data transfer access
- Day 3–7: ingestion, baseline runs, tuning
- Day 8–21: A/B ramp to target concurrency, automated evals
- Day 22–30: human eval + final report

If that works, Liam — please confirm PO contact details and any internal billing constraints.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOW + SOC2 + pricing estimate (Aperture evaluation)

Emma / Vanessa — quick technical notes to unblock ingestion and the A/B test.

1) S3 layout: we expect a gzipped newline-delimited JSON (ndjson.gz) with these top-level fields per event: "session_id", "timestamp", "transcript", "session_flags". If you prefer Drive, a CSV is fine but we need the session_flags column intact.

2) Presigned ingest: once the bucket is shared, I'll generate a presigned PUT key for Redwood ingestion. We recommend a one-time presigned URL per file (we'll provide a short script).

3) API keys and routes: we'll provision a trial API key tied to the evaluation and two routes: /summaries-short and /summaries-long. The trial API key will be valid for 35 days and scoped to Aperture's test project.

4) Runtime profile & autoscaling: for the target peak of 120 req/s we'll use a continuous-batching config to keep p99 in range. If you decide to start at 50 req/s first week, we'll keep the same deployment and scale behind the scenes.

5) Data retention confirmation: please confirm if 30-day purge is acceptable; if yes we will mark that in the SOW and schedule the automated purge.

Action items and owners: 
- Emma: share S3 link or Drive folder + confirm retention (due: 2026-05-18 EOD).
- Liam: review SOW and advise PO timeline (due: 2026-05-19).
- Rishi: will send presigned URL script and ingestion checklist once S3 is shared (ETA: same day).
- Vanessa / Rachel: we'll coordinate the human-eval panel scheduling (target week 4).
